movie.title: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse
movie.overview: Hunted by Miguel O'Hara's Spider Society and betrayed by his friends, Miles finds himself in the darkest corners of the Spider-Verse in search of a way home. Knowing that his family has been not only fractured but endangered by his calling, it's a race against the clock for Miles to travel across the wildest reaches of time and space to fight for and reunite everything he holds most dear.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Hunted across the Multiverse by the Spider Society and stranded in a dark alternate reality, Miles Morales must race against time to save his father and restore balance to the Spider-Verse.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Following the shocking revelations and betrayal that left him trapped in Earth-42, Miles Morales finds himself pursued by Miguel O'Hara and the formidable Spider Society. With his home dimension threatened by the terrifying power of the Spot, Miles must navigate the darkest corners of the Multiverse to find a way back to Earth-1610. Meanwhile, Gwen Stacy assembles a trusted team of allies to locate Miles and help him rewrite his fate. Ultimately, Miles must face his ultimate challenges to protect his family and redefine what it truly means to be a hero.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Pick up directly after the harrowing cliffhanger of Across the Spider-Verse, Miles Morales is trapped on Earth-42, a dark world where Spider-Man never existed and a villainous version of himself reigns as the Prowler. Back on Earth-1610, the Spot's cosmic threat reaches a boiling point as he prepares to destroy everything Miles loves, starting with his father, Jefferson Davis. Meanwhile, Miguel O'Hara and the Spider Society relentlessly hunt Miles to enforce canon events and preserve the structural integrity of the Multiverse. Undeterred, Gwen Stacy forms her own band of rogue Spider-People—including Peter B. Parker, Hobie Brown, Pavitr Prabhakar, and Penny Parker—to track down Miles and offer aid. Trapped between hostile enemies, existential multiversal collapse, and deeply personal betrayals, Miles must rely on his inner strength to escape Earth-42. As collision courses converge across multiple dimensions, Miles battles impossible odds to challenge predetermined destinies and save both his father and the Spider-Verse itself.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse serves as the epic conclusion to the revolutionary animated trilogy. After the jaw-dropping events of Across the Spider-Verse, Miles Morales finds himself separated from his home, hunted by Miguel O'Hara's militaristic Spider Society, and confronted by an alternate reality where his life took a drastically darker path. Armed with the determination to defy fate and break the tragic cycles defined by 'canon events,' Miles must navigate uncharted dimensions to return to Earth-1610 before the Spot unleashes total catastrophe. Joined by Gwen Stacy and a defiant crew of loyal Spider-heroes, Miles fights an unprecedented war on multiple fronts—testing the bonds of family, friendship, and heroism in a high-stakes adventure across time and space.

story_structure.climax: A colossal, high-stakes confrontation bringing Miles, the Spider Society, and the Spot together in a desperate battle where the survival of multiple dimensions and Miles' family hangs in the balance.
story_structure.conflict: Miles faces a complex, multi-front struggle: evading Miguel O'Hara's relentless Spider Society, escaping alternate-universe threats, and stopping the Spot before he destroys Miles' home universe and family.
story_structure.resolution: The dust settles as Miles redefines what it means to choose his own destiny, restoring order to the Spider-Verse and reconciling fractured bonds with those he loves.
story_structure.introduction: Trapped in an alternate, hostile reality without his powers or allies, Miles Morales must navigate the dark consequences of the multiversal rift while coming to terms with his isolation and his family's impending danger.
story_structure.risingAction: Miles embarks on a high-stakes, dimension-hopping race against time to return to Earth-1610, while splinter groups of allies assemble to help him defy predetermined fates and alter multiversal canon.
